name: Orbitorium
summary:
Orbitorium is a cozy space puzzle about gravity, played with your hands.

A small universe floats in front of you: a launch pad, a glowing portal, and space in between. Pinch a planet from your console and place it anywhere in the box. Press **LAUNCH**: the rocket burns straight up, then coasts, and every planet you placed pulls on it. Get the pulls right and its path bends all the way into the portal. Get them wrong and it sails off into the dark, or into a rock. The dashed trail of your last flight stays
